overall_summary: Most videos achieve low to moderate views, but relationship dynamics and family roles (specifically husband-wife and complex emotional realities) significantly outperform standard poetic or generic family tropes. The video on husband-wife dynamics (or5gtaBpRVY) heavily outperformed everything else with 1,662 views.

winning_patterns.evidence: Video ID or5gtaBpRVY about wives/husbands got 1662 views; NO5fdHLxFL4 about relationship realities got 371 views.
winning_patterns.action: Focus more heavily on complex interpersonal relationship realities, misunderstandings, and unspoken expectations between partners.

winning_patterns.evidence: rl_ycNbXZ_g ('आज किसी अपने को Call कर लेना') performed well at 288 views compared to simple statics.
winning_patterns.action: Include a soft, empathetic call-to-action or realization prompt within the title or early hook.

weak_patterns.pattern: Generic family member praise without conflict
weak_patterns.evidence: Sister videos (jfmMztnam_A, fAAoIQCRMXU) stayed extremely low at 18 and 134 views respectively.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid flat praise of family members; instead, focus on relational tension, unspoken emotional distance, or emotional maturity.
